recipes.name: 家常白粥

recipe.chineseServing: 约2小碗；照片主体为原味白粥，背景配菜不属于本方。 大米明确为干白粳米；所有粥汤均分，未测成品每100克。
chineseSteps: 用600毫升饮用水分2次轻淘大米，弃去淘米水并沥干。
将80克大米和900毫升煮粥水放入至少2升容量的锅，煮开时搅动锅底。
小火留缝加盖，保持轻微冒泡煮35–45分钟，每隔5–10分钟搅动锅底。如变得过稠，可分次加入0–200毫升热饮用水。
米粒煮至完全柔软、无硬芯且粥体顺滑后关火，静置2分钟。原味食用，或撒上可选的3克葱花。
recipe.englishServing: About 2 small bowls; the photo centers on plain congee, and background side dishes are separate. Rice is explicitly dry white japonica; divide all porridge liquid, with no measured per 100 g finished-food value.
englishSteps: Gently rinse the rice in 2 changes of water using 600 ml drinking water in total; discard the rinse water and drain.
Combine 80 g rice and 900 ml cooking water in a pot of at least 2 L capacity, stirring the bottom as it comes to a boil.
Partly cover and simmer gently over low heat for 35–45 minutes, stirring the bottom every 5–10 minutes. If too thick, add 0–200 ml hot drinking water in small additions.
Turn off the heat when the grains are fully soft with no hard centers and the porridge is smooth. Rest for 2 minutes, then serve plain or add the optional 3 g scallion.

recipes.name: 红烧冬瓜

image.author: HowToCook repository contributors; see source-file history

recipe.chineseServing: 编辑估计：按原文“每份”用量，约可做2小份。
chineseSteps: 冬瓜去皮，切成边长不超过2厘米的小块；姜切末，香葱切末。另将淀粉与30毫升清水调成水淀粉备用。
锅中加入食用油，中火加热后放入冬瓜，缓慢翻动煎炒约2分钟，直到表面略带金黄。
把冬瓜盛出备用。利用锅中余油，放入姜末、生抽和蚝油，翻炒约15秒。
倒回冬瓜，翻炒约30秒，加入250毫升开水。煮开后加盖，以中小火煮约10分钟；如水将烧干而冬瓜仍硬，每次加50毫升开水，最多再加100毫升。
加入老抽调色，继续煮到冬瓜变软糯、筷子能轻松插入。
加入料酒、香葱，鸡精按需加0–1克，轻轻翻匀煮约30秒；将冬瓜和少量汤汁盛入碗中。
将10克玉米淀粉和30毫升水调成的水淀粉重新搅匀，边搅边全部倒入锅中余汁；煮开约1分钟至略稠。将全部酱汁浇在冬瓜上，均分2份。
recipe.englishServing: Editorial estimate: based on the source’s per-serving amounts, this makes about 2 small servings.
englishSteps: Peel the winter melon and cut it into pieces no larger than 2 cm on a side. Mince the ginger and chop the scallion. In a separate bowl, mix the starch with 30 ml water to make a slurry and set aside.
Add the cooking oil to a pan or wok and heat over medium heat. Add the winter melon and gently turn it for about 2 minutes until the surface is lightly golden.
Transfer the winter melon to a bowl. Using the remaining oil in the pan, add the minced ginger, light soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and stir-fry for about 15 seconds.

Return the winter melon and stir-fry for about 30 seconds. Add 250 ml boiling water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes. If the pan is drying out before the melon is tender, add water in 50 ml increments, up to 100 ml more.
Add the dark soy sauce for color and keep cooking until the winter melon is tender and a chopstick can slide in easily.
Add the cooking wine and scallion, plus 0–1 g bouillon powder if desired. Stir gently and simmer for about 30 seconds, then transfer the winter melon and a little broth to a bowl.

Stir the slurry of 10 g cornstarch and 30 ml water again and pour all of it into the remaining sauce while stirring. Simmer for about 1 minute until lightly thickened. Pour all the sauce over the melon and divide into 2 portions.

recipes.name: 银耳莲子红枣甜汤

image.author: Project-commissioned OpenAI ImageGen output
image.license: Project-generated synthetic image; no third-party source photograph

recipe.chineseServing: 3碗甜汤；不含米，银耳8克及莲子40克均为干重，红枣20克为干果去核净重。
chineseSteps: 8克干银耳以500毫升冷水在冷藏处泡约1–2小时至完全舒展，按包装需要调整时间；沥去泡水、冲净并撕成约2厘米小片。40克干莲子和20克去核干红枣快速冲洗，检查去除残留莲心或枣核。
容量至少2升的锅加入1000毫升水、银耳和莲子，烧沸后转小火，半盖煮约50–60分钟，间歇轻搅防粘，保持缓慢冒泡，不大火煮干。
加入20克红枣再小火煮约20–30分钟，至莲子可用勺背轻压碎、银耳软滑。如果汤过稠可从可选150毫升水中每次加50毫升；未用的补水不倒入。
加入15克冰糖搅拌约3–5分钟至完全溶解，不再分两次重复加糖。若莲子仍硬，继续小火煮并复查。全部汤和固形物均分3碗。
recipe.englishServing: 3 bowls of dessert soup without rice; 8 g snow fungus and 40 g lotus seeds are dry weights, and 20 g dried jujubes is pitted edible weight.
englishSteps: Soak 8 g dried snow fungus in 500 ml cold water under refrigeration about 1–2 hours until expanded, adjusting time to package directions. Drain soaking water, rinse and tear into pieces about 2 cm. Quickly rinse 40 g dried lotus seeds and 20 g pitted dried jujubes, checking for remaining green embryos or pits.

In a pot holding at least 2 liters, combine 1000 ml water, snow fungus and lotus seeds. Bring to a boil, reduce to low and simmer partly covered about 50–60 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Maintain gentle bubbling without boiling dry.

Add 20 g jujubes and simmer another 20–30 minutes until lotus seeds crush easily with the back of a spoon and fungus is soft and slippery. If too thick, add optional water from the 150 ml allowance in 50 ml increments; do not add unused top-up water.

Stir in 15 g rock sugar about 3–5 minutes until completely dissolved, without adding a second sugar allocation. If lotus seeds are still firm, continue simmering and recheck. Divide all broth and solids evenly among 3 bowls.

recipes.name: 西红柿豆腐汤羹

image.author: HowToCook repository contributors; see source-file history

chineseSteps: 番茄切1厘米丁，豆腐切1.5厘米块，鸡蛋打散。将5克淀粉与20毫升冷水搅匀。
汤锅中火热5毫升油，姜末炒10秒，加入番茄炒2–3分钟至变软出汁。
加350毫升热水、豆腐和1.5克盐，煮沸后轻煮2分钟。重新搅匀淀粉水后缓缓倒入，轻推锅底，煮30秒至略稠。
保持汤轻沸，蛋液细流淋入，待10秒再轻推成蛋花，继续轻煮30–60秒至鸡蛋完全凝固，撒葱花盛出。
recipe.englishServing: 2 small bowls of lightly thickened soup containing egg.
englishSteps: Dice tomato into 1 cm pieces and tofu into 1.5 cm cubes; beat the egg. Mix 5 g cornstarch with 20 ml cold water.
Heat 5 ml oil over medium heat, cook ginger for 10 seconds, then cook tomato for 2–3 minutes until softened and juicy.

Add 350 ml hot water, tofu and 1.5 g salt. Bring to a boil and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Stir the slurry again, pour it in slowly while gently stirring along the base, and simmer for 30 seconds until slightly thickened.
Keep the soup gently bubbling and pour in egg in a thin stream. Wait 10 seconds, then gently stir into ribbons. Simmer for 30–60 seconds until the egg is completely set, add scallion and serve.
